criteria.narrative:
To earn this certificate a learner must hold a current course certificate for each of these courses: AI for Retail and E-commerce Professionals (CMC-110); Building and Deploying AI in Retail and E-commerce (CMC-210); Building and Deploying AI in Media and Entertainment (CMC-250); Copyright, IP and Licensing in Generative AI (GOV-260). Every course certificate must be current (not revoked or expired) when the program certificate is issued; the program certificate is renewed when every course certificate is current again.

Each course exam is taken online and is not proctored. The holder's identity is not verified; the name is the one on their account. This is a program certificate of completion and assessment issued by Wirewalk Institute of AI. It is not an accreditation, academic credit, license, or a certification from any vendor. Details: https://institute.wirewalk.com/certification/#limits
